component.name: RackForge
component.summary: Play modelled instruments and effects from a MIDI keyboard

description.p: RackForge is a musical runtime: it plays portable instrument and effect plugins from a MIDI keyboard, with a rack for chaining them, controller mappings and programs. The Standard edition includes a physically modelled concert grand, a tonewheel organ, an electric piano, an accordion, synthesizers and studio effects.
Sound goes through the desktop's sound server, so RackForge shares the audio interface with the rest of the desktop.
